run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program with given env vars and args to collect test lists per iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases on a list of full test names to extract unique test case names
run_CalculateTestLists: run CalculateTestLists to populate global test lists for all, active, filtered, and sharded tests
test_GTestShuffleUnitTest: test that GTest shuffle preserves test count, changes order, and does not interleave test cases
review_ShuffleFlag: review the ShuffleFlag helper that returns the --gtest_shuffle command line flag string
